name: Hellmann's / Best Foods Real Mayonnaise
whyItWorks: Made from soybean oil, water, whole eggs and egg yolks, vinegar, and salt. It is an ultra-smooth emulsion containing 0g fiber, zero dairy, and zero lactose. Provides easy, calorie-dense fats to prevent weight loss during recovery without irritating the bowel.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Spread 1 tablespoon onto white bread for turkey sandwiches, or mix with drained canned tuna. Limit to 1–2 tablespoons if experiencing active bile acid malabsorption.
watchOuts: High in fat (10g per tablespoon); enjoy in moderate portions to avoid rapid gastric emptying.
